request: add some gardens and fences to smaller houses

entries.prompt: Use case: precise-object-edit. Asset type: a production sprite atlas for the isometric transport building game Transport. The supplied image is the EDIT TARGET, a transparent 3 by 3 atlas of nine houses. Keep a precisely regular 3x3 grid and generous clear transparent gutters. Modify ONLY FOUR houses: all three houses in the TOP ROW, and the bungalow in the MIDDLE ROW RIGHT column. Add modest, attractive, clearly visible small gardens and low fences to these four plots. Each plot should have a short path from a visible open fence gate to its front door; fence runs along two visible plot boundaries, geometrically aligned to the isometric ground axes. Use low fences so facades remain readable. Make the four gardens and fences different. Keep the roof shape, materials, architectural identity, windows, chimney, colors and fixed orthographic 2:1 dimetric viewpoint of every building. Ground edges at plus/minus 26.565 degrees, vertical walls, identical northwest illumination. Maintain the realistic detailed painted game-sprite rendering and muted palette; details must survive downscaling to about 48 pixels. Keep the other FIVE buildings unchanged: middle-row left and center and all bottom-row houses. Fit each edited house and its entire garden inside its original cell, moderately reducing the house size ONLY if needed to create room for the garden. Garden size should remain modest and the house should still dominate the plot. No opaque rectangular cards, no tall trees, no labels, no people, no text, no border, no new shadows outside each plot, no neighboring plots touching. REAL transparent background, preserve soft original alpha/contact shadows. Output a square transparent atlas. TAIGA: cottage with muted green grass, a few soft lilac/cream flowers and a weathered pale wooden picket fence; timber cabin with a small vegetable patch, berry shrubs and rustic dark split-rail fence; brick terrace with two tidy front flowerbeds and low charcoal metal railing; bungalow with small lawn, lavender beds, low timber fence and a little hedge. Soft earthy colors, flowers are restrained accents, avoid bright saturated greens or whites.
